subject: Hospitality
title: The Golden Triangle
description: A quick win: understand The Golden Triangle.

hook.text: When you open a menu, your eyes follow a predictable pattern: center first, then upper right, then upper left.

buildup.text: Eye-tracking studies confirm this pattern. Menu designers place the highest-margin items where eyes land first.

discovery.text: Boxes, borders, photos, and icons draw attention to specific items. A simple box around a dish can increase its orders by 20%.

twist.text: Digital menus break the pattern. On tablets and phones, guests scroll linearly—top to bottom.

climax.text: The best menus guide without manipulating. Guests should feel they chose freely while being nudged toward profitable choices.

punchline.text: Center, upper right, upper left. Your eyes are predictable—menus are designed for it.

quiz.question: Where do eyes land first when opening a physical menu?
options: The center—then upper right, then upper left (the Golden Triangle)
